Are you an experienced payroll and HR administration professional who enjoys ownership, accuracy, and variety? jobs.occupation: R&D Group Manager – Compute Platforms & Silicon Prototypes
jobs.description:
Lead the team that turns breakthrough compute architectures into working silicon for the future of AI, high-performance computing and automotive systems.
 

About the role
 

What if you could lead the team that transforms breakthrough chip architectures into real silicon?

At imec, you will manage a multidisciplinary group developing advanced compute platforms and silicon prototypes that explore the future of artificial intelligence, high-performance computing (HPC) and automotive systems. Your work will help define how next-generation chips are designed, integrated and manufactured beyond today's conventional system-on-chip approaches.

You will combine scientific leadership, people management and technology vision in one of the world's leading semiconductor research environments.

 

What you will do
 

As R&D Group Manager, you will lead a team of architects and engineers developing advanced compute systems from concept to silicon validation.

You will:
 
 

• Lead a team of chip architects, silicon designers and R&D engineers. 

• Translate novel computing concepts into manufacturable silicon demonstrators. 

• Drive the development of next-generation compute platforms based on RISC-V and chiplet-based architectures. 

• Guide projects across the complete development cycle, from architectural exploration to prototype fabrication. 

• Enable close collaboration between architecture, software, design technology and silicon implementation experts. 

• Build a high-performing team by coaching, mentoring and developing researchers and engineers. 

• Help shape imec's vision for future 3D-integrated computing systems.  

Who you are
 

You combine deep technical expertise with strong people leadership.

You bring:

Must-have
 
 

• 10+ years of experience in digital system architecture and semiconductor design. 

• Solid understanding of advanced chip and compute-system development. 

• Experience with RISC-V or similar processor architectures. 

• Previous experience leading engineers, researchers or technical experts. 

• Strong communication skills and fluency in English.  

Nice-to-have
 
 

• Experience with chiplet-based architectures and die-to-die interconnect technologies. 

• Knowledge of hardware modelling and hardware generation methodologies. 

• Experience with advanced verification methodologies and design automation flows.

jobs.occupation: Startup and Ecosystem Manager – EU Chips Design Platform
jobs.description:
Help Europe’s most ambitious semiconductor startups move from breakthrough ideas to market-ready chips.
Apply About the role 
 

Europe is investing heavily in semiconductor innovation, and the EU Chips Design Platform is at the center of that transformation.

As a Startup and Ecosystem Manager, you'll become a trusted partner for startups, SMEs, research organizations and fabless innovators across Europe. You'll guide them through the platform, connect them with the right expertise and resources, and help accelerate their path from concept to silicon.
 

What you will do
 

In this role, you'll combine ecosystem building, stakeholder management and startup support.

You will:
 
 

• Guide and onboard users of the EU Chips Design Platform throughout their innovation journey. 

• Act as the primary contact for startups, SMEs and research teams using the platform. 

• Manage imec's contribution to the Venture Development Program, including mentoring, incubation and acceleration activities. 

• Support participants in applying for Financial Support to Third Parties (FSTP) funding opportunities. 

• Promote the platform across the European semiconductor ecosystem. 

• Build strong relationships with startups, investors, competence centers and industry stakeholders throughout Europe. 

• Identify opportunities to improve the user experience and continuously strengthen the platform's services. 

• Help shape a thriving European chip design community.

   

Why this role is unique
 

This is more than an account management role. You'll help build the ecosystem that enables the next generation of European chip companies to succeed. It offers the unique combination of: 
 
 

• Direct impact on Europe's semiconductor future. 

• Daily interaction with ambitious deep-tech startups. 

• Exposure to a broad network of innovators, investors and technology leaders. 

• The opportunity to help build a flagship initiative under the European Chips Act. 

• The reputation, expertise and global reach of imec behind you.  

You'll have the chance to influence how tomorrow's chip companies are created, funded and scaled.

Who you are
 

We're looking for someone who combines technical understanding with a passion for helping innovators succeed, with:
 
 

• A PhD, Master's degree or equivalent experience in microelectronics, electrical engineering, physics or a related field. 

• Knowledge of ASIC design and semiconductor development. 

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. 

• A customer-focused mindset and entrepreneurial attitude. 

• Willingness to travel frequently (10 % of your time) mostly in Europe. 

• Excellent English communication skills.  

It’s an asset if you also bring: 
 
 

• Experience working with startups or innovation ecosystems. 

• Familiarity with venture development, incubation or accelerator programs. 

• An existing network within the European semiconductor ecosystem. 

• Experience with multiple chip design flows or EDA tools.

jobs.description:
To strengthen his Finance team at his Brussels headquarters, our client is looking for an AP Accounting Specialist. 

Client Details

Our client is a leading international retailer known for its collaborative culture, innovation, and continuous improvement mindset.

 

Description

• Manage and reconcile financial transactions, ensuring accuracy and compliance with accounting standards.
• Participate in monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities and support financial reporting under BE GAAP and IFRS.
• Perform complex account reconciliations, including intercompany and fixed assets accounts.
• Analyze and optimize financial processes by implementing automation and efficiency improvements.
• Partner with operational teams (stores, e-commerce, logistics) to provide financial insights and support decision-making.
• Identify financial risks, strengthen internal controls, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
 

 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Management with at least a first experience in a similar role.
• Strong accounting knowledge with the ability to independently manage complex reconciliations (intercompany, fixed assets).
• Proficient in Excel, with an interest in ERP systems and Generative AI tools.
• Organized, proactive, and able to manage priorities effectively while meeting strict deadlines.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain financial information to non-financial stakeholders.
• Fluent in Dutch with a good command of French and English; committed to continuous learning and process improvement.

Let's talk business
 
 

• Ready to take on the world? Because in this role you’ll implement MES systems at our customers in the plastics and textile industry worldwide. This includes both new installations as implementing upgrades. 

• You'll be prepping installations and fine-tuning applications to ensure a smooth installation at the customer. 

• You’ll install and configure the software on-site, taking into account the specific needs of the customer. You’ll be a guru to our customers: you’ll guide, train and support them when they start using our systems. 

• You will be part of a larger worldwide team but in this role your colleagues from the Installation and Service team and the Development team will be your work besties. 

• When you're not out in the field, you'll be the go-to guy or girl for our HQ, providing top-notch remote support to our customers. It's your change to dive into challenges, solve issues, and keep things running smoothly. 

Let's talk you
 
 

• You hold a Master's degree in ICT, NMCT, electronics or have an equivalent knowledge about MES gained through hands-on experience. We also offer technically skilled school leavers the opportunity to embark on an adventure with us. 

• Knowledge of Windows systems and relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server) is a plus, just like basic knowledge of MES or ERP systems. 

• You're open to the occasional trip abroad to connect with our customers and experience different cultures. 

• As an autonomous, customer-oriented, and stress-resistant person, you thrive on finding solutions and delivering top-notch service. Fluent communication and killer teamwork skills are a must. 

• You can express yourself practically in different languages. Fluency in English is a must, and you should be confident communicating in at least two additional languages to support our global customer base effectively.
